Brief: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered. — about Major projects

Kept:
1. Although the Hubble observatory is nearing the end of its life, there are still major projects scheduled for it.
2. One example is the current (2022) ULLYSES project (Ultraviolet Legacy Library of Young Stars as Essential Standards) which will last for three years to observe a set of high- and low-mass young stars and will shed light on star formation and composition.
3. Another is the OPAL project (Outer Planet Atmospheres Legacy), which is focused on understanding the evolution and dynamics of the atmosphere of the outer planets (such as Jupiter and Uranus) by making baseline observations over an extended period.
